test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, MOTHER is written as 541203, FATHER is written as 961203 and PARTNER is written as 7631803. How will PANTHER be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e975eec7941f96b2014ca014cc7041899af15adb33154ee8a8af306f9ba4b7e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

MOTHER is written as 541203,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7723bd19b1a705f5490f37a709060549e5cd672d171f7da32bed06a8f0b9c87.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/784b8224a8a8fe164b972cbaf8675b522902043eb6fce9800ae0d67fd47cd97d.png] 

FATHER is written as 961203

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c35d549ce92026acb1f364046b468ba0da68094ba1e1e838ea44078830308df.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18eacfd97f7f329bd6c63b6e74d52e2512f7de6e33cb6e64dd380d645ef4bea9.png] 

PARTNER is written as 7631803.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/235ff0e3dac3e4f4adbeeaa957606768171e3e2d5bd0b010b52789fd5073615a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a056d55e88544134b5a00921da2681cbd0f3437f6cb78eba7a367fc573b19b5c.png] 

Similarly, **PANTHER **will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03f1dc7c017b2b920e0e86ed43943d31fb969bfc31146f801ab24e9ccef3d754.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9356e4f54631127854585af0835fb1c34ebf334deac43bdea4e1a4a8faf5d523.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "7681203".**
